statement: Crash-fault consensus requires an explicit failure and timing model; whenever a crash erases the only distinguishing message, processes with identical retained views cannot be required to decide differently, and any stronger guarantee needs an added lawful detector or synchrony record.
title: Crash-fault consensus boundary
